description: Create a weekly piano practice log spreadsheet. Add column headers for Date, Duration (min), Pieces Worked On, Technique Focus, Tempo (bpm), and Notes. Enter 5 practice sessions with dates, durations (45, 60, 30, 15, 90 minutes), pieces practiced, techniques, tempos, and notes. In row 8, calculate the total weekly practice time using a SUM formula. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/practice_log.xlsx.
